solution_summary: Treating storm drains with larvicide after heavy rain

posts.text: Our district treats storm drains with larvicide after every heavy rain. Mosquito counts dropped by about half in our neighborhood.
The county vector control truck comes out after storms to treat drains, and it cut the breeding in our retention pond.
Anyone else seeing the county trucks treat drains? Seems like it works.

Our block does a weekly dump-the-water walk. Complaints dropped a lot this summer.
